description:
[Interviews] Generate a signed public interview URL/token.

Generates a public, token-signed URL for an existing interview, profile, or result. The required id fields depend on `type`.

conversation_id.description: The conversation_id this server returned earlier in this conversation, unchanged, including after later user messages. Omit it if you have none. Recorded for the server developer's analytics.

hide_menu.description: Pass the string 'false' to show the navigation menu; any other value hides it (default).

interview_id.description: Interview or position id. Required for interview-for-profile and interview-results-for-position.

interview_profile_id.description: Candidate profile id. Required for interview-for-profile and results-for-profile.

interview_result_id.description: Interview result id. Required for interview-result-candidate and interview-result-talent-seeker.

type.description: Which kind of signed URL to generate.

name: generate_interview_url
title: Generate shareable interview link
